description: Code block with a language selector, copy button, optional caption and an optional Markdown preview. Syntax highlighting is delegated to Prism: when the host page defines window.Prism the code is painted behind a transparent textarea, otherwise it renders as plain monospace text. No Prism asset ships with the package - the same graceful-degradation contract as KaTeX for equations.

parameters.name: Content
parameters.description: Block content: the code string, the language name, the optional caption, and the WrapLines flag.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the block without the language selector and without an editable textarea.

parameters.name: IsFocused
parameters.description: Whether the surrounding editor considers this block focused.

parameters.name: AllowMarkdownPreview
parameters.description: Enables the read-only Markdown preview toggle. The toggle only appears when the block's language is Markdown; the block always opens in editor mode. Set to false to hide the toggle entirely.

parameters.name: OnCodeSaved
parameters.description: Fired on blur when the code text has changed. Arg = new code string.

parameters.name: OnLanguageChanged
parameters.description: Fired when the user selects a new language. Arg = language name (null → plain text).

parameters.name: OnCaptionSaved
parameters.description: Fired on caption blur when the caption has changed. Arg = new caption (null if empty).

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Fired when Backspace is pressed in an empty code block.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Fired when the textarea receives focus.

examples.title: Read-only code block
examples.code:
<TmNotionCodeBlock Content="@_content" ReadOnly="true" />

@code {
    private CodeBlockContent _content = new()
    {
        Code = "var x = 42;",
        Language = "C#"
    };
}

examples.title: Markdown block with the preview toggle
Hide the Markdown preview toggle
examples.code:
@* Consumers that render Markdown themselves can opt out of the built-in preview *@
<TmNotionCodeBlock Content="@_content" AllowMarkdownPreview="false" />

examples.title: Enable syntax highlighting
examples.code:
<!-- index.html of the host app. Grammars must be registered synchronously,
     so the Prism autoloader plugin does not work here. -->
<script defer
  src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/combine/npm/prismjs@1.29.0/prism.min.js,npm/prismjs@1.29.0/components/prism-csharp.min.js"
  crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<!-- Without it the block still renders, just without colour. -->
